## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. State whether maths, payouts,
RNG, media, timing or save behaviour changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck, existing tests and renderer build checked
- [ ] Affected behaviour checked; untested paths listed
- [ ] Visible changes shown in windowed and full-screen modes, if applicable
- [ ] No personal data, credentials, generated output or unrelated changes

Maintainer review is still required. Passing checks is not visual approval.
